competition_format.label: Pre-draft exits, team draft, elimination fights, semi-finals, live finals

steps.label: Before the draft
steps.rule: Eighteen fighters arrived, nine per division. Before the draft one was injured out, one left the show, and one forfeited his match. None of these was a bout.

steps.label: Team draft
steps.rule: A coin flip gave Franklin the first pick, and each coach drafted eight fighters, four per division.

phases.label: Elimination fights
phases.rule: Team challenges decided which team chose the next matchup, and the loser of each fight left the competition. A fighter could fight more than once, a replacement could take a withdrawn winner's place, and a fighter could reach the last four without a house fight.

phases.label: Semi-finals
phases.rule: Dana White, Franklin and Hughes set the semi-final matchups with input from the fighters.
